description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal, handling local storage, mock data seeding, and interactions with a Supabase backend for requests, user sessions, and profiles. It includes functions for creating, updating, and retrieving requests, managing user sessions, and normalizing vehicle and contact data.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either in Supabase or local storage, with vehicle, issue, and contact info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via Supabase or local storage, returning user info and role.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clearing session data.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user info from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listUnassignedRequests
methods.description: Lists requests not assigned to any mechanic, from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listMyAssignments
methods.description: Lists requests assigned to a mechanic, via Supabase join or local storage.

methods.name: getRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a specific request by ID from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: acceptRequest
methods.description: Assigns a request to a mechanic, updating status and notes in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: updateRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of a request in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile data in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Supabase environment variables are set.
